product-experience-pulse.description: Summarizes adoption, feedback, response speed, and the current workflow-completion availability state.

adoption-and-engagement.description: Shows how much the product is used and how observed session activity changes over time.

channel-mix.description: Shows the observed distribution of eligible user queries by entry channel.

experience-and-response-quality.description: Brings together response-quality signals and adjacent feedback and latency context without implying causation.

trust-and-measurement-readiness.description: Shows the availability and decision-readiness of safety, security, evaluation, and prompt-injection evidence.
